name: io.github.cyanheads/openfda-mcp-server
description: Query FDA data on drugs, food, devices, and recalls via openFDA. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

environmentVariables.name: OPENFDA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free API key from open.fda.gov — increases daily limit from 1K to 120K requests.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'duckdb' to enable DataCanvas staging: stage=true or a canvas_id on an openfda_search_* tool or openfda_lookup_ndc stages the matched records as a SQL table, and the openfda_dataframe_* tools are listed. The DuckDB binding ships with the server.

environmentVariables.name: OPENFDA_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable openfda_dataframe_drop, which deletes a table staged on a DataCanvas. Off by default; applies only when DataCanvas is enabled (CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb).

environmentVariables.name: OPENFDA_MIRROR_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Serve exact-key lookups for drug/label, drug/ndc, drug/enforcement, and drug/drugsfda from a local bulk mirror instead of the API. Off by default; the initial harvest runs out-of-band via the mirror:init script.

environmentVariables.name: OPENFDA_MIRROR_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding one SQLite file per mirrored dataset.

environmentVariables.name: OPENFDA_MIRROR_REFRESH_CRON
environmentVariables.description: Cron expression for the in-process mirror refresh. HTTP transport only; stdio operators run mirror:refresh from the host. Requires the optional node-cron peer dependency.

environmentVariables.name: OPENFDA_MIRROR_FALLBACK_LIVE
environmentVariables.description: Fall back to the live API when the mirror is cold, missing the record, or failing. Disable to fail loudly instead.

environmentVariables.name: OPENFDA_MIRROR_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Wall-clock budget for one scheduled refresh before it is aborted. Raise it for drug/label, the only multi-partition dataset.

environmentVariables.name: OPENFDA_MIRROR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Host serving the openFDA bulk download manifest. Override only to harvest from a private mirror of the dumps.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: OPENFDA_API_KEY
